package rulefixtures

import "sync"

// scenario for go_perf_layer_garbage_collection_cleanup_sync_pool_stores_large_unbounded_buffers: Layer: Garbage collection and cleanup. Flag sync.Pool usage that stores large buffers without a cap before putting them back.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
var scenario542BufferPool = sync.Pool{
	New: func() any {
		return make([]byte, 0, 1<<16)
	},
}

func scenario542GetBuffer() []byte {
	return scenario542BufferPool.Get().([]byte)
}

func scenario542PutBuffer(buf []byte) {
	scenario542BufferPool.Put(buf)
}

func scenario542Positive(data [][]byte) [][]byte {
	var results [][]byte
	for _, chunk := range data {
		buf := scenario542GetBuffer()
		buf = append(buf, chunk...)
		results = append(results, buf)
		scenario542PutBuffer(buf)
	}
	return results
}
